$comment: Template MCP server config. Copy this file to .vscode/mcp.json and edit paths/env vars for your local environment. The .vscode/mcp.json file is gitignored so your local paths never leak to source control.

playwright.$comment: Playwright MCP — required by the Explorer for web/hybrid scenarios. The --viewport-size below sets the Explorer browser to 1920×1080. Keep this value aligned with output/playwright.config.ts → projects[].use.viewport so Explorer and Executor see the app at the same size. Change or remove if your test suite runs at a different viewport.

appium-mcp.$comment: Appium MCP — required by the Explorer for mobile/mobile-hybrid scenarios. Requires: Appium server running on localhost:4723, ANDROID_HOME env var set, Git on PATH (npm needs it for transitive deps), device connected via ADB. NOTE: the version is PINNED (not @latest) — using @latest causes npx to hit the npm registry on every Explorer agent invocation, adding 1-3 minutes of cold-start time. Update the version manually when a newer release is verified by your team. Run `npm view appium-mcp version` to see the current latest. TROUBLESHOOTING: if you hit cold-start hangs, TLS cert errors, EBUSY/EPERM during install, or 'spawn git ENOENT', see docs/onboarding/android-device.md §10 — and consider switching to the global-install alternative documented in §5.1 (more reliable on Windows + corporate networks).
